Getting that right is one of the most critical and complex challenges at Legora. Every jurisdiction holds billions of pages of critical legal text scattered across hundreds of sources – statutes, case law, regulatory guidance, secondary materials, and more. Only about 3% is publicly accessible on the web. The rest is buried across courts, agencies, and archives. Getting this right doesn't just improve a product feature — it shapes how lawyers around the world navigate legal information for the next several decades. As a Legal Data Analyst at Legora, you will own this challenge. You will be the person who is responsible for mapping the legal source ecosystem, determining and prioritizing what we go after, and how this content shall be structured and systematized — the one who makes sure we actually get legal data right. Few roles at the company will have more direct impact on Legora AI’s ability to navigate the law correctly. What you will be doing: - Map the legal data landscape across key jurisdictions — structuring how statutes, case law, secondary sources, and regulatory content interrelate, building a clear picture of what exists, where it lives, and how it connects - Conduct deep dives into individual sources, assessing available material, document types, commercial value, and the legal preconditions for data acquisition - Prioritise data acquisition based on client demand, user value, and Legora's broader data coverage strategy - Serve as the critical link between legal knowledge and our engineering teams — translating the nuances of each source into actionable briefs that enable our engineers to get the most out of every dataset - Own the quality and accuracy of the legal data layer that underpins Legora's global legal research product Who you are - You are a detail-oriented lawyer with an exceptional track record — academically, professionally, or both - You are excited about what AI is doing to the legal industry and you want to be close to that shift - You find
